hook: A language model just rewrote its own weights.
hookText: An LLM edits its own weights

beats.say: A new paper shows an open twenty-seven billion parameter model that is given its weights and graded answers, then diagnoses its own failures.
With no gradients and no training, it rewrites its weights and gets six point six points more accurate on problems it never saw.
It can even repair a damaged copy of itself to over eighty percent of the original accuracy, and only the largest models manage it.
